headline: Viridis Mining Signs Long-Term Rare Earth Supply Deal with Solvay
summary: Viridis Mining and Minerals signed a binding long-term off-take agreement with Solvay to supply rare earth production from its Colossus project in Minas Gerais, Brazil.
why: Solvay is a global chemical firm, and securing rare earth element off-take supports international diversification of critical green technology materials.

impacts.name: Viridis Mining and Minerals
impacts.why: Securing a binding customer contract provides commercial validation and project financing support.
